title: Characterization of valid circuit encodings
statement: For every bit string $w$, its validity indicator is true if and only if there exist a number $n$ of input vertices and a directed acyclic circuit on those inputs, with output a circuit vertex, whose gates read only earlier vertices, whose argument lists have no repeated entries, whose NOT gates have exactly one argument, and whose gates each have at most two arguments, such that the circuit encodes to $w$.
